expedition: Seascape Alaska 5: Gulf of Alaska Remotely Operated Vehicle Exploration and Mapping
purpose: This is a geologically complex area at the intersection of the subduction zone and the Yakutat Terrane, where the sedimentary cover of the Yakutat Terrane is being accreted to the North American Plate and its oceanic basement is subducting underneath southern Alaska. This is a virtually unexplored area and the rocks potentially encountered encompass a wide variety of potential lithologies and structures.
